categories.main_business_segments: Anhui XDLK Microsystem Corporation Limited primarily engages in the research, development, testing, and sales of high-performance silicon-based MEMS inertial sensors. Its main products include MEMS gyroscopes and MEMS accelerometers, which are key components in inertial systems used for navigation, positioning, attitude sensing, and platform stabilization in high-end industrial, unmanned systems, and high-reliability fields.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced MEMS microfabrication technology combined with ASIC chip design to produce integrated inertial sensors. It operates a fabless model, outsourcing wafer fabrication to specialized foundries and performing packaging and testing in-house or through partners. The company has developed proprietary MEMS chip designs and process schemes, including multi-axis gyroscopes, resonant accelerometers, and pressure sensors, supported by a comprehensive R&D team and a closed-loop technology system.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include high-end industrial sectors, surveying and mapping, petroleum exploration, commercial aerospace, intelligent driving, and high-reliability applications. The company has secured orders from automotive-grade clients and actively expands into emerging markets such as low-altitude economy and autonomous driving, serving both domestic and international markets with a focus on precision and stability requirements.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and R&D centers in Anhui Province and Beijing, and subsidiaries in Hebei and Hong Kong. Its sales are concentrated in North China, South China, and East China regions, with growing international market presence through its Hong Kong subsidiary Moving Star Limited.
categories.supply_chain_position: Anhui XDLK operates mainly in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless MEMS sensor design and testing company. It relies on upstream wafer foundries for MEMS and ASIC wafer fabrication and downstream packaging and testing partners, maintaining control over design, testing, and calibration processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on enhancing MEMS gyroscope and accelerometer performance, developing automotive-grade MEMS IMUs for L3+ autonomous driving, high-precision pressure sensors, and underwater navigation systems. It emphasizes technology innovation, talent development, and expanding product lines to maintain leadership in high-performance MEMS inertial sensors and broaden applications across multiple industries.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales and buyout distribution of MEMS inertial sensor products, including gyroscopes, accelerometers, and inertial measurement units. The company also earns income from technical services related to its products. Sales contracts are fulfilled upon product delivery and customer acceptance, with revenue recognized at the point of control transfer.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international leaders such as Honeywell and ADI in the high-performance MEMS inertial sensor market. While its product performance is at an international advanced level, it currently holds a smaller market share and operates on a smaller scale without self-owned wafer fabs. The company positions itself as a domestic leader focusing on high-end industrial and automotive applications, aiming to expand market share through innovation and quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 404.5 million, a 27.57% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 222.17 million, up 34.33%. R&D expenses accounted for 27.07% of revenue, reflecting a 36.52% increase in R&D investment. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.38 billion with a net asset growth of 9.7%, demonstrating strong growth momentum and expanding operational scale.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Anhui XDLK emphasizes its proprietary high-performance MEMS inertial sensor technology with superior precision, stability, and environmental adaptability, comparable to international advanced products. Its sensors offer miniaturization, high integration, and cost advantages, suitable for demanding applications in industrial, aerospace, and automotive sectors. The company’s closed-loop R&D and supply chain collaboration enable rapid innovation and reliable mass production, delivering differentiated value through performance and customization.
